title: TotemCPvP
description: The Best CrystalPvP Texturepack out there!
body:
**TotemCPvP**
1. small Totem pop particles
2. clean animated big sized Totems

4. small shield that doesnt take too much of your screen
5. old enchantment glint more powerful enchantment glint
6. clean tight Armor
